statement: N-0074 stable address. Question: which fixed hostname should CIP live on? Options: (a) a domain Warren already owns, moved to (or added as a zone in) a free Cloudflare account, named tunnel on a subdomain such as cip.<domain>; (b) buy a new domain through Cloudflare Registrar (about USD 10 a year) and do (a); (c) keep the quick tunnel (free, no account, but the address changes on every restart and company managed Chrome blocks *.trycloudflare.com). Evidence: PILOT_TUNNEL_RUNBOOK section H (browser block), N0073_DISCOVERY.md. Assumptions: this PC stays the host for now; a cloud VM is a later, separate choice. Impact: (a)/(b) give one link users can bookmark and that company Chrome opens; optional Cloudflare Access can add an email check in front of /login at no cost for up to 50 users. Reversibility: high (delete the tunnel and DNS record). Resolving step: Warren signs in with cloudflared tunnel login on this PC; the agent never handles the Cloudflare credential. Recommendation: (a) if a domain exists, else (b).
